transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Hi. Well, I came in because things have been kind of overwhelming lately. I went from barely settling into my new apartment to... suddenly saying yes to all these mentoring sessions. I started taking on extra client prototypes for work, and I'm redesigning my whole portfolio. It just felt like I had to fix my entire life in one sprint, and I realized I probably need some help figuring out what's going on.
Have you noticed feeling unusually upbeat, irritable, or high lately—like you don’t need much sleep, or that you can take on way more than usual without feeling tired?

Yeah, I have. Earlier this month, I felt... I guess almost electric? Just really upbeat and ready to go. But it wasn't just a good mood. One minute I'd be like that, and the next I was snapping at a contractor for work, or getting mad at my sister over really tiny delays. It just felt like they were personally trying to block me from getting things done.
Have you noticed that you needed less sleep than usual during that time when you felt really upbeat and energetic? Like you could keep going with very little rest?

Yeah, exactly. For several nights there, I slept maybe... three or four hours? But I didn't feel exhausted at all. I woke up convinced I was totally fine, and I just figured I should use the extra time to get ahead on my projects.
During that time when you felt so energized and upbeat, did you find yourself needing to keep moving, doing things, or felt restless inside?

Yeah, definitely. I couldn't just sit still. There were nights where I was constantly moving around—like, I’d be moving furniture, labeling all these storage bins, or tweaking my design mockups for work. I was even just pacing through the apartment at times, because the idea of actually stopping just felt impossible. I had to be doing something.
How long did you feel this way—like you were really upbeat, energetic, and didn't need much sleep?

I'm not exactly sure, honestly. I didn't really keep track of the exact days. Um... maybe it was a few days? Or closer to a week? I just know it was a solid stretch of time earlier this month where I was just constantly going, but I couldn't give you an exact number of days.

During that time when you felt so energized, did you find yourself working on multiple projects at once, jumping from one task to another rapidly, or feeling driven to accomplish things more than usual?

Yes, absolutely. That's actually a big part of why I decided to come in. I went from just barely trying to settle into my new apartment to suddenly... well, taking on everything. I started saying yes to mentoring sessions, took on extra client prototypes for work, and decided I needed to redesign my entire portfolio right then and there. It was like I felt driven to fix or upgrade my entire life in one massive sprint. I was just jumping from one thing to the next constantly.
Can you think back to that time when you felt so energized and driven—was there a specific day or event that marked the start, and did it feel like it came on suddenly or built up gradually?

Um, I can't really point to a specific day or event that started it. It's hard to say if it was sudden or gradual. I just kind of realized I was in the middle of all this energy and activity, but I don't remember exactly how it began. It just sort of happened.
